title: Sunflower Punk Poses
description: A triptych painting on a bright green background shows three poses of the same anime-style character with spiky black hair, sunflower accessories, and a yellow-and-black punk outfit. The left panel depicts the character crouching with sunflowers in hand, the center shows a dynamic standing dance pose with one hand raised, and the right panel captures a confident striding pose with tail-like sunflower chain.
prompt: A triptych acrylic painting on a vibrant lime green background featuring three distinct poses of a fierce anime-style male character with spiky black hair, yellow sunflower hair accessories, and a yellow and black punk rock outfit with belts, chains, and sunflower details. Left panel shows him crouching playfully holding sunflowers, center panel shows him in a dynamic dance stance with one hand raised, right panel shows him striding forward confidently with a tail-like sunflower chain, all rendered in a bold illustrative style with thick outlines.
